about: File system samples for the synced-folder and network check (A1 3.2, M3.09). 'captured' samples were read on a real machine with fs.statfs and the mount table (Node 26.13.1), keeping only the file system's type, never a source or a person's path. 'constructed' samples carry the values of the Linux kernel's include/uapi/linux/magic.h and the file systems' own sources, or macOS mount(8)'s output format, for file systems no machine here mounts. 'expect' is what the check reports: 'local' for a file system known to keep its files on this machine, the network file system's word, or 'unchecked' for any other.
